# Asia Open: Supply Tightening and Prices Accelerating  
**Bottom line:** Expect tighter supply and faster price growth; lock in pricing on neutral‑risk parts now, but buy ahead on elevated‑risk items.

## What changed
- Market supply risk sits at 65.7 (‑0.6) and price trend at 86.5, both “Rising” with high confidence 79.3 %[1].  
- Semiconductor PPI surged +32.6 % annualized over the last three months, pushing both supply tightness and price hikes[1].  
- Global chip sales jumped +148.3 % YoY to $172.6 B in Sep 2026, reinforcing demand pressure on supply and prices[2].  
- Fab utilization slipped to 74.4 % (below the 10‑yr avg 80 %), a modest loosening factor[3].  
- TSMC’s 3‑month revenue rose +56 % YoY, indicating heavier foundry loading and tighter downstream supply[4].

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time 14 weeks, channel stock 27,071 units (≈17.6 weeks of inventory).  
- Price $5.56 per 1 unit, $2.51 per 1,000 units.  
- Origin Austria, tariff 0 % (no surcharge).  
- Supply risk 51.2 (Neutral); price trend 68.6.  
- Call: **Lock pricing (no need to buy ahead)** – 70 % chance prices rise in 3 months, but supply is adequate; fix price now, keep normal ordering cadence[5].

## Alerts  

*(none)*  

## Segment board
- Processors & advanced logic – Supply 65.4 (Rising, –0.6), Price 83.5 (Rising), High confidence.  
- Memory (DRAM/NAND/HBM) – Supply 64.7 (Rising, –0.5), Price 74.3 (Rising), High confidence.  
- Analog & power – Supply 64.4 (Rising, +0.4), Price 81.7 (Rising), High confidence.  
- Microcontrollers – Supply 64.0 (Rising, +0.7), Price 81.1 (Rising), High confidence.  
- Power discretes – Supply 61.8 (Rising, +0.2), Price 78.2 (Rising), High confidence.  

## Your BOM watchlist
- **10M08SAE144C8G** – Lead time 52 weeks vs 12‑week norm; price +129 % vs target.  
- **LCMXO2-1200HC-4TG100C** – Same 52‑week lead, price +41 % vs target.  
- **XC7A35T-1CSG324C** – 52‑week lead, price +60 % vs target.  
- **LM358DR** – Lead time 26 weeks, price +26 % vs target.  
- **IS25LP128-JBLE** – 52‑week lead, price +42 % vs target.  

All carry “Elevated” supply risk (≈77) driven by extreme factory lead times.

## Outlook
- Chip prices in the next 3 months: 77 % chance of rise, expected +7.05 % (80 % range ‑4.66 % to +18.76 %); model‑tested edge.  
- Chip prices in the next 6 months: 76 % chance of rise, expected +14.1 % (‑1.13 % to +29.33 %); trend‑following baseline.  
- Fab utilization in 3 months: 52 % chance of tightening, expected +0.12 pts (‑3.17 to +3.41 pts); baseline.  
- Fab utilization in 6 months: 51 % chance of tightening, expected +0.23 pts (‑5.23 to +5.7 pts); baseline.  

## Negotiation angle
1. **Lock pricing on neutral‑risk parts** like the Infineon MOSFET (IPB017N10N5ATMA1) to avoid the 70 % upside price risk while maintaining regular lead times.  
2. **Buy ahead on the five elevated‑risk items** (10M08SAE144C8G, LCMXO2‑1200HC‑4TG100C, XC7A35T‑1CSG324C, LM358DR, IS25LP128‑JBLE) to hedge against 52‑week lead times and >40 % price premiums.  
3. Push suppliers for **visibility on capacity releases** tied to TSMC’s loading surge and Korea export momentum, citing the 0.6‑point supply‑risk dip as leverage for better terms.
